questions.source_content:
INSPECTION COMPLIANCE REPORT
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Pali
Date: 23 March 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/203)
Subject: Physical Verification of Biometric Attendance and Office Punctuality Logs (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Pali division are hereby informed that under 'Physical Verification of Biometric Attendance and Office Punctuality Logs', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 8 March in the central pending wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #303) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Pali, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and pending movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Pali), 2. Budget Reconciliation #113, 3. Digital Indexing.
Nodal Officer (Audit)
Rajendra Prasad Meena
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the First Paragraph.
2. Click Justify and select Line Spacing '2.5'.
